t:
The Armed Forces are authorized strengths for active duty personnel as of September 30, 2013, as follows:
    (1) The Army, 552,100. 
    (2) The Navy, 322,700. 
    (3) The Marine Corps, 197,300. 
    (4) The Air Force, 329,460.

fable.w: This section only sets authorized end strengths for active duty personnel in each military branch. There is no tempting reading here: it mentions no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government is involved in any decision.
